evidence.decision: Defines meaningful inverse/history units and grouping, preserves standard commands and reveals offscreen changes; rejects cosmetic reversal of irreversible external effects.
evidence.artifact: Requires action/inverse/grouping/boundary/label/reveal contract with corrected command logic or review.
evidence.transformation: Drawing example groups continuous slider changes, names the target and reveals restored offscreen text instead of opaque repeated Undo.
evidence.verification: Checks edit sequences, grouped drag, redo invalidation, offscreen restoration and save/open policy; wrong target or false external reversal fails.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies TV/Watch exclusion, Mac Edit shortcuts and system-provided iOS Undo/Redo title prefix; native gestures need actual tests.
evidence.handoffs: Edit menus, Feedback and Drag and drop cover relevant command access, visible recovery and transfer reversal.
evidence.distinctiveness: History granularity, inverse semantics and visible restoration are specific to reversible editing.
